title: Balanced actions on affine sections of the direct-image algebra
statement: Let $A,B$ be commutative rings with an $A$-algebra structure on $B$, $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-affine-spectrum], and $M$ a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $\rho:B\to\operatorname{End}_{\mathcal O_X}(M)$ be a unital ring map with $\rho(a)=f^\sharp(a)$ acting on $M$ for every $a\in A$. Put $Y=X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}A}\operatorname{Spec}B$ [def-pc-fibre-product], with projections $\pi$ and $f_B$, and $C=\pi_*\mathcal O_Y$. There is a unique family of unital ring maps $\tau_U:C(U)\to\operatorname{End}_{\mathbf Z}(M(U))$, indexed only by affine opens $U\subseteq X$ [lem-weil-pbc-affine-opens-basis], such that: for every inclusion $i:V\subseteq U$ of affine opens, $\tau_U(r)(x)|_V=\tau_V(r|_V)(x|_V)$; for $d\in\mathcal O_X(U)$, $\tau_U(\pi^\sharp(d))(x)=dx$; and for $b\in B$, $\tau_U(f_B^\sharp(b)|_{\pi^{-1}U})(x)=\rho(b)_U(x)$. This asserts actions on affine sections only, with no module sheaf or action on other opens.

proof.text: For each affine open U apply balancedAction_affine_open to obtain its uniquely determined ring action. Choose this unique action pointwise; the uniqueness hypothesis determines the actual data, rather than choosing an arbitrary existence witness.

For an inclusion U into V, apply affineBaseChange_sections_induction on V to restriction compatibility, quantified over all module elements. For the O_X(V) generators use naturality of pi and semilinearity of module restrictions. For the B generators use composition of restrictions from the top open and naturality of rho(b). Ring-map preservation of addition and multiplication and additivity of restrictions give the two induction steps.

The factor identities hold on each chosen action. Any other family with those identities agrees pointwise by balancedAction_affine_open uniqueness; dependent function extensionality proves uniqueness of the family.

lean.statement:
theorem balancedAction_affine_sections
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of A))
    (M : X.Modules) (hM : M.IsQuasicoherent)
    (rho : B →+* End M)
    (hscalar : ∀ a : A, rho (algebraMap A B a) =
      M.smulHom (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of A)).inv ≫ f.appTop).hom a)) :
    let g := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B))
    let Y := pullback f g
    let pi : Y ⟶ X := pullback.fst f g
    let fB : Y ⟶ Spec (.of B) := pullback.snd f g
    let C := (TopCat.Sheaf.pushforward CommRingCat.{u} pi.base).obj Y.sheaf
    ∃! tau : ∀ U : X.affineOpens,
      C.obj.obj (op U.val) →+* AddMonoid.End (M.val.obj (op U.val)),
      (∀ (U V : X.affineOpens) (i : U.val ⟶ V.val)
        (r : C.obj.obj (op V.val)) (x : M.val.obj (op V.val)),
        M.val.map i.op (tau V r x) =
          tau U (C.obj.map i.op r) (M.val.map i.op x)) ∧
      (∀ (U : X.affineOpens) (r : X.presheaf.obj (op U.val))
        (x : M.val.obj (op U.val)), tau U (pi.app U.val r) x = r • x) ∧
      (∀ (U : X.affineOpens) (b : B) (x : M.val.obj (op U.val)),
        tau U (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top (a := pi ⁻¹ᵁ U.val))).op
          (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of B)).inv ≫ fB.appTop).hom b)) x =
            (rho b).val.app (op U.val) x)
